question: When does jim propose to pam on the office?
text: Jim proposes to Pam in **“Weight Loss,” the Season 5 premiere** of *The Office*, which originally aired on **September 25, 2008**. He pops the question at a gas station in the rain. If you’re watching on Peacock, the scene is in **Season 5, Episode 2 (“Weight Loss Part 2”)**. ([youtube.com](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=N56tjXt6JoY&utm_source=openai))
